title: Add SpellCheck for the TextArea element
body:
Fixes #904 

- Add this attribute to the `textarea` element to handle spell check
- JSONEditor handle it automatically

yep, I think only the Private message is `textarea`, the rest is div and it was manipulated by JSON Editor with the spell-chck enabled

I just do some search and found that components that using the `textarea`:
- MessageCreator: line 217 (Private messages)
- Textarea: line 25

This is a deployment from `develop`.  I can't find a text area that _doesn't_ have spell-check working:
https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/

I'm not sure what made the clients come up with the requirement.

Ok, closing this issue.  The underlying issue is the Chrome is using an Internet service for spell-check.

Our Serge players don't have an Internet connection - that's why spell-check isn't provided.  We need a different strategy than using the browser-default strategy.

issues.title: Correctly manage port number
issues.body:
## 🧰 Ticket
The code to configure the port number was breaking the Cypress e2e tests, since Cypress builds need a port number.

However, the fixed script broke the comms on a MS Windows installation.

This PR fixes the runtime comms on MS Windows, and is available for test on other environments, including Heroku.

comments.body: This version works on local, Travis (Cypress) and Heroku. Fixed!
